phase_a_orientation.summary: UserSyncService.sync(userId) is @Transactional and makes up to five attempts. Each attempt fetches the profile via RemoteUserClient.fetchProfile(userId), then persists it with UserRepository.saveProfile(userId, profile), returning after success. Any Exception from either fetch or save is swallowed, so the whole fetch/save sequence is retried; after five failures the method exits silently without reporting failure.
